summary: Short main-road kerb with bus zone and houses 5 m away.

best_section.where: Whitmore Street east kerb at the bus stop

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartments within 5-15 m along the whole stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane only; bus zone signed at the start.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a signalled junction nearby.
drivers.convention: A few cars park near the start but the bus zone blocks the rest.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the west side and the north end.
